<function name="RegisterMetaTable" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Registers a given table as a metatable. It can then be accessed by other code/addons via <page>Global.FindMetaTable</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2024.06.04</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="metaName" type="string">The new metatable name. Cannot override existing types.</arg>
		<arg name="metaTable" type="table">The new metatable table. It will be given a `MetaID` and `MetaName` fields.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
